# A03-S02: Literary technique

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Hej [████]

Thank you. The fact that I tell about the emotional reaction is also because
I am affected by being without a contract. My situation is precarious until
then.

Honestly, it's hard for me to answer whether the text is written by an
AI or me. The answer is simply: both.

It is because of the technique I used. I took a
third text, which I did not write myself, but saw a
potential in. Then I changed the names in the text, and let GPT-3continue
on each sentence. Gradually I rewrote, asked questions,
and tried to follow what GPT-3 is good at saying something about, and what it is
less good at. So it is neither a dialogue between me and AI nor
curated AI, but AI as a literary technique. I do not know myself, and cannot
remember where the AI and I actually begin and end. It is a use
of GPT-3 as a kind of automatic writing or thinking machine, where I am
the connection between different forms of human and machine
writing.

But that part does not have to be part of the work.

Looking forward to getting started :-)
